title: Investment Overview
description: Where your investments stand: how much you put in, what it's worth now, unrealized gain, income, allocation, and value over time.

widgets.title: Invested
widgets.helpText: The cost basis of the holdings you still own — what you paid for them.

steps.query: SELECT :currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.book_value AS REAL)), 2) AS amount FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 WHERE l.cost_currency = :currency HAVING amount IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Current Value
widgets.helpText: Market value of your holdings at the latest recorded price.

steps.query: SELECT :currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price), 2) AS amount FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = :currency HAVING amount IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Unrealized Gain
widgets.helpText: Current market value minus cost basis. Green if up, red if down. Holdings without a recorded price are not included.

steps.query: SELECT :currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price - CAST(l.book_value AS REAL)), 2) AS amount FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = :currency HAVING amount IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Investment Income
widgets.helpText: All dividends and interest earned to date, in this currency.

steps.query: SELECT :currency AS currency, ROUND(SUM(CAST(amount AS REAL)) * -1, 2) AS amount FROM postings WHERE (account LIKE 'Income:Dividends%' OR account LIKE 'Income:Interest%') AND currency = :currency HAVING amount IS NOT NULL

widgets.title: Allocation by Asset Class
widgets.helpText: Current market value split by asset class (ETF, stock, money-market, and so on).

steps.query: SELECT c.asset_class AS name, ROUND(SUM(CAST(l.units_number AS REAL) * lp.price), 2) AS value FROM lots l JOIN commodities c ON c.code = l.units_currency AND c.is_currency = 0 JOIN (SELECT base_currency, quote_currency, CAST(quote_number AS REAL) AS price FROM prices x WHERE x.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM prices y WHERE y.base_currency = x.base_currency AND y.quote_currency = x.quote_currency)) lp ON lp.base_currency = l.units_currency AND lp.quote_currency = :currency GROUP BY c.asset_class HAVING value > 0 ORDER BY value DESC

widgets.title: Value Over Time
widgets.helpText: Monthly market value against what you put in (cost basis). Months where a holding had no recorded price fall back to cost.

visualization.emptyText: No holdings to chart in this currency yet.
